digest.component_or_area: test suite — Jira adapter (DC and Cloud)
propositions: Five tests have vacuous or incomplete assertions that cannot fail or only partially verify their docstring contracts despite appearing to provide coverage.
Test 1 constructs a transport without a credential and asserts a PAT is not in repr(), which is tautological since no PAT reaches the object and the class has no custom __repr__.

Test 2 re-implements the pagination-guard predicate inline instead of calling the shared helper, so breaking the predicate leaves the test green; the helper must be parameterized to accept optional source.
Test 3 asserts only that validate_assignee_exists exists via hasattr(), not that it returns a username string for DC or accountId for Cloud, missing the real contract.

Test 4 asserts total <= 1 client calls (which 0 satisfies, meaning the 429 branch is never reached) instead of == 1, and uses blanket pytest.raises(Exception) instead of asserting the specific BackendHTTPError and .code == 429.
Test 5 asserts BackendRegistryError is not a KeyError but never actually calls select_backend or exercises the registry behavior, only pinning a class relationship.
